# China Filter Hub (Huiying)

> Main site: https://chinafilterhub.com (placeholder domain chinafilterhub.com)
> Data subsite: https://data.chinafilterhub.com (placeholder domain)
> Product information & database hub for automotive, HVAC and cleanroom filters.
> Operating legal entity: Qinghe County Huiying Automotive Parts Co., Ltd. (credit code 91130534MA0958NT84).

## Categories

- [Air Filters (Engine Intake)](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/air-filters/): 空气滤清器
- [Cabin Air Filters](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/cabin-filters/): 空调滤清器
- [Oil Filters](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/oil-filters/): 机油滤清器
- [Fuel Filters](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/fuel-filters/): 燃油滤清器
- [Hydraulic Filters](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/hydraulic-filters/): 液压滤清器
- [Transmission Filters](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/transmission-filters/): 变速箱滤清器
- [HVAC Filters](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/hvac-filters/): HVAC 过滤器
- [HEPA / ULPA Filters](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/hepa-filters/): HEPA/ULPA 过滤器
- [Activated Carbon Filters](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/activated-carbon/): 活性炭过滤器
- [Pocket / Bag Filters](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/pocket-filters/): 袋式过滤器
- [Filter Media](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/filter-media/): 滤材介质
- [Liquid Filter Cartridges](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/liquid-cartridges/): 液体过滤滤芯
- [Cleanroom Equipment](https://chinafilterhub.com/products/cleanroom-equipment/): 洁净室设备
